# watchpoint_incident_update_template (Resource)

A reusable incident update for the status page composer. The body may use `{{component}}`, `{{start_time}}`, `{{title}}`, `{{status}}`, `{{impact}}`, `{{page}}` and `{{duration}}`, filled from the incident when the template is inserted; unknown variables are left as written. Requires `status_pages.manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_incident_update_template" "investigating" {
  name          = "Investigating (default)"
  status        = "Investigating"
  body_markdown = "We are investigating degraded performance on **{{component}}** since {{start_time}}. Next update within 30 minutes."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body_markdown` (String) Markdown body (10000 characters max).
- `name` (String) Unique name within the tenant (120 characters max).

### Optional

- `status` (String) Incident status the composer switches to when the template is used: `Investigating`, `Identified`, `Monitoring` or `Resolved`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Template ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_incident_update_template.investigating iut_001
```
